description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
No-LN 5-block net: L0 heads gather 7 digits; MLPs compute slope one-hot, gated s*(q-x1), tens/ones one-hot, pos-gated readout.
Same circuit but heads gather digits as scalar values (7 slot dims instead of one-hot), d_model 72.
4 blocks: scalar slots; slope one-hot; A; tens scalar via steps; position-gated triangle readout of tens/ones.
4-block scalar-slot net with per-block MLP widths (15,11,18,60) sized exactly to the units each stage uses.
Per-block widths plus d_model shrunk to 56 with 7 heads (one per gathered digit).
Attention inner width decoupled from d_model: d_head=2 (value dim + qk dim), 7 heads.
Cleaned-up dhead2 model: 7 gather heads (d_head 2), slope one-hot, gated s*(q-x1), tens scalar, pos-gated readout; d_model 56, 4 blocks.
Y1 heads also write 10*tens+ones directly into the answer scalar A; removes the Y1 copy unit from block 1 MLP (d_ff 10).
Gather heads write coefficient-weighted digits directly into derived scalars dx, dy, q-x1 and A=y1 (3 dims instead of 7 slots).
d_head=1: each head's query, key and value are scalars (position match score, digit value).
Compact residual layout, d_model 46 (13 token, 13 position, dx/dy/q-x1/A, slope one-hot, tens, 10 outputs).
Readout logit_k = -|V-k| (2 ReLUs per digit, position-gated) instead of 3-ReLU indicator triangles; final MLP width 40.
Tens logit read directly from A as -distance(A,[10k,10k+9]); FAILED (0.375) because gate G=20 is smaller than A (<=99) so the gated-off units leak.
Same tens-from-A readout with gate G=100 > max A; fixes the leak.
Residual keeps only 10 digit-token dims and 9 used position dims; d_model 39.
Token embedding is a single scalar dim holding the digit value (non-digits 0); d_model 30.
Position embedding (p, p^2, 1): heads match a source position via -(p-sp)^2 score; readout gate linear in p. d_model 24.
quad_pos_d24 with attention sharpness 30 -> 10. Failed; I first blamed leakage amplified by gate gain M=50 but later found the logit-tie bug (see logit_margin rows) is also involved.
quad_pos_d24 with attention sharpness 20 (neighbour weight e^-20).
Block 2 writes the ones digit A mod 10 directly (A - 10*sum of steps) instead of a tens scalar; block 3 reads it.
Tens-digit readout (distance of A to [10k,10k+9]) moved into block 2 next to the ones-scalar; block 3 only reads out the ones digit.
Target-position query comes from W_q bias instead of a constant 'one' residual dim; d_model 23.
Slope hypothesis score = |dy - s*dx| (2 ReLUs per s) and block 1 gates with -50*mismatch instead of a 3-ReLU indicator; block 0 width 10.
slope_mismatch_abs with the smallest safe gate gain M=46 (> max |s*t| = 45).
gate_M46 with sharpness 15 (no logit margin yet). Failed: correct digit logit ~ -1e-5 loses to non-digit logit 0 (debugged by printing predictions).
Fix: +0.5 margin on digit logits via last fc2 bias; sharpness 15, M=46.
With the margin, probe how soft attention can be: sharpness 8. 46% (genuine attention leakage amplified by M).
Probe: sharpness 12 with margin, 1000/1000 on seed 3 (row accuracy re-measured later with the sharpness-20 build, 2000/2000).
Final: scalar token/quadratic position embeddings, 7 d_head-2 heads write dx,dy,q-x1,A; slope-mismatch gating (M=46); ones scalar; -dist readouts with +0.5 margin; sharpness 20; d_model 23, 4 blocks.
